description: This Java class handles update commands for external service configurations within the Fineract platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, processes JSON commands, and delegates the update operation to ExternalServiceWritePlatformService.

classes.name: UpdateExternalServiceConfigurationCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler class that processes update commands for external services, marked as a Spring Service, implementing command interface and delegating to a service layer.

methods.name: UpdateExternalServiceConfigurationCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects ExternalServiceWritePlatformService dependency via constructor injection.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to update external service configurations and returns the result.
